text: Registration for a workshop closes 48 hours before its listed start time. Places cannot be held after the deadline.
A cancellation made at least 72 hours before the start receives a full account credit. Later cancellations receive no credit.
Accessibility requests should be sent to access@example.test at least five calendar days before a workshop. A support coordinator replies within two working days.
Attendance certificates are issued only after a participant completes every session. Certificates arrive by email within three working days after the final session.
Loaned equipment must be returned to reception within seven calendar days after a workshop ends. Late returns pause future equipment loans.
Participants may enter up to 15 minutes after the start. After that time, entry is not allowed because the safety briefing has ended.
Online workshop links are emailed to registered participants 24 hours before the start. Participants should check the spam folder if the message is missing.
Group bookings can include at most six participants. Every participant needs a separate email address.
